instagram.author: brittanyperilleee
instagram.body:
Comment APP 🔥 20 minutes of INTENTIONAL AF training on your bathroom floor TRUMPS an hour of random exercises while your brain is halfway through tomorrow’s to-do list. 💯

And if you’re frustrated with your results, ladies, bring your BRAIN 🧠 into the workout. HOW are you breathing? WHERE are your ribs in relation to your pelvis? WHICH muscles are ACTUALLY doing the work?

After having babies, those details matter A LOT!

And I don’t care how many years it’s been since you had your last baby. You’re a postpartum Woman for LIFE! 

Your training needs to honor what your body went through and support the body you’re in TODAY.

Your abs stretched 🥵 to make room for your baby. Your rib cage widened, and it can feel harder to get those ribs moving again. Your pelvic floor muscles lengthened, and your pelvis and hips adapted to basically a watermelon 🍉 sitting inside of it. 

Honestly, SO incredible. BUT!! We don’t want to stay STUCK in those adaptations. A HUGE amount of women are, until NOW 💪🏼🔥

Here’s what I’m working on in my bathroom:

✨ Rotating through my MID-BACK and using a band to feel my breath expand into the sides and BACK of my ribs.

✨ Using a Copenhagen to get my inner thighs and lateral abs working together.

✨ Finding my proximal hamstrings with my feet on the chair, then reaching to bring my serratus into a cross-body connection.

✨ Training my hamstrings, glutes, and abs together in a bridge.

✨ Learning to BREATHE while my abs are doing their job under a BRACE.

This is what I mean by functional training. I want you to be able to take these skills into a lift, into picking up your kids, and into building your strongest, most aesthetic physique. You can build it and MAINTAIN it. 🔥

So on the days all you have is 20 minutes and a bathroom floor, USE THEM 👊🏼

tiktok.author: jerrysfitnesstips
tiktok.body:
Top 3 best free fitness apps for the gym #Fitness #gym #apps #workout #tracking
Here are the three best free fitness apps of 2026. The third one is the best. First up is Heavy. Heavy is a workout tracking app that makes it super easy to track your workouts, but also review your progress, which also has a built in community to help you stay motivated. Number two, we have Strava. Strava is great for cardio when it comes to tracking your runs and bike rides. You can also follow your friends and see what they're doing, all for free. No. 3 and in my opinion the best app, check out Fitness Refined. Fitness Refined builds personalized workouts around your goals and equipment. It's in app AI, lets you explain the workout you want and it'll create it for you. Say you've only got 30 minutes, dumbbells and want to do chest. You got it. And more importantly, each exercise features a real personal trainer demonstrating proper form from different angles. Those were my three favorite fitness apps right now. Let me know what I missed and what your favorite one is in the comments below.
